filing_office: Illinois Secretary of State, Department of Business Services
filing_fee_notes: Standard domestic LLC formation is 150; series LLC formation is 400. Online report payments also incur a processor fee.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain a consenting Illinois resident individual or authorized entity as agent. The registered office must be in Illinois and match the agent's business office; a P.O. box alone is insufficient.
expedite_options: The forms schedule lists an additional 100 for expedited standard Articles of Organization; turnaround was not confirmed.
annual_report_due: Before the first day of the anniversary month each year; the anniversary month is the month of organization.
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and maintain an Illinois registered agent. File the annual report before the anniversary month begins.
common_mistake: Waiting until the end of the anniversary month to file the annual report.
notes: Standard domestic LLC scope; series-specific annual-report charges are not covered. Formation URL is the official online-services gateway. Direct name-search URL, standard processing time, franchise/privilege tax, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed and are null.
